summary_en: Mito Securities announced an interim dividend of 20 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027, comprising 17 yen in regular dividend and 3 yen in 105th anniversary special dividend. The company also reaffirmed its commitment to a minimum annual dividend of 30 yen per share through fiscal 2030, with a baseline dividend payout ratio of approximately 50%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Planned Interim Dividend for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Regular Dividend and 105th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Mito Securities announced a planned interim dividend of 20 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027, payable with a record date of September 30, 2026. This comprises a regular dividend of 17 yen per share and a commemorative dividend of 3 yen per share, marking the company's 105th anniversary, which occurred in April 2026. The board of directors made this decision on September 17, 2026, pending formal approval at a board meeting scheduled for late October 2026.

The company reaffirmed its shareholder return policy, setting a minimum annual dividend of 30 yen per share for each fiscal year from March 2026 through March 2030. This multi-year commitment reinforces the company's strengthened shareholder return posture. The baseline dividend payout ratio is approximately 50%, with consideration given to dividend sustainability and the company's financial position. The company also maintains a policy of opportunistic share repurchases based on comprehensive assessment of market conditions and business performance.
